mainDialogue.title: Station Engineer
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello, You got any spare Electronic Parts by chance?

nextDialogue.title: Station Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: There's no more in Engineering.

nextDialogue.title: Station Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: And it's harder and harder to find them.

nextDialogue.title: Station Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: We are not getting enough from visiting ships

nextDialogue.title: Station Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: If nothing change,

mainDialogue.title: Miner
mainDialogue.plainText: You got Dream Dust or Oxymore?

nextDialogue.title: Miner
nextDialogue.plainText: I got a long expedition ahead.

nextDialogue.title: Miner
nextDialogue.plainText: We will be heading out to the asteroid belt again.

nextDialogue.title: Miner
nextDialogue.plainText: Working 12 hours shifts.

nextDialogue.title: Miner
nextDialogue.plainText: Need something to help me get through it.

mainDialogue.title: Mid-Level Nurse
mainDialogue.plainText: *Walk swiftly to the storefront*

nextDialogue.title: Mid-Level Nurse
nextDialogue.plainText: I have a bunch of meds.

nextDialogue.title: Mid-Level Nurse
nextDialogue.plainText: Need to sell them all. Today.

nextDialogue.title: Mid-Level Nurse
nextDialogue.plainText: 33% off if you take the lot.

mainDialogue.title: Lower Level Nurse
mainDialogue.plainText: My clinic asked me to get medical supplies.

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Nurse
nextDialogue.plainText: The clinic is swamped.

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Nurse
nextDialogue.plainText: The staff is working 24/7.

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Nurse
nextDialogue.plainText: We rely only on donations

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Nurse
nextDialogue.plainText: and there's never enough meds

mainDialogue.title: Sick Scav
mainDialogue.plainText: *COUGH*

nextDialogue.title: Sick Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: Hello, do you have High-Quality Water?

nextDialogue.title: Sick Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: Clinic said I've been drinking too much bad water.

nextDialogue.title: Sick Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: And I need to drink High-Quality Water for a month.

nextDialogue.title: Sick Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: Else, I won't get better...

mainDialogue.title: Scav
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, I just got back from a scav run.

nextDialogue.title: Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: There's less and less to find on the Station.

nextDialogue.title: Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: Anything not behind locks in the Abandoned Sections is picked clean.

nextDialogue.title: Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: I heard stories about scavs turning on others down there.

nextDialogue.title: Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: and coming back to sell off their looted gear.

mainDialogue.title: Security Officer
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, you got any snacks or treats?

nextDialogue.title: Security Officer
nextDialogue.plainText: Or caffeine pills or cigarette?

nextDialogue.title: Security Officer
nextDialogue.plainText: It's another day patrolling the Lower Levels.

nextDialogue.title: Security Officer
nextDialogue.plainText: Feels like I can get shanked anytime here.

nextDialogue.title: Security Officer
nextDialogue.plainText: Can't wait until they promote me.

mainDialogue.title: Wounded Man
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey! Do you have any meds?

nextDialogue.title: Wounded Man
nextDialogue.plainText: I need them now, I've been shot!

nextDialogue.title: Wounded Man
nextDialogue.plainText: I can't go to the clinic, it's too risky.

nextDialogue.title: Wounded Man
nextDialogue.plainText: Some gang members invaded our turf,

nextDialogue.title: Wounded Man
nextDialogue.plainText: trying to push their product.

mainDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello shopkeep!

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: I am visiting the Lower Levels

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: Wanted to experience life down here!

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: I must say, the Lower Level's culture is truly charming.

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: Up there, it gets pretty boring.

mainDialogue.title: Mercenary
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey there, You got weapons, ammo or armor?

nextDialogue.title: Mercenary
nextDialogue.plainText: You are new right? Didn't see you before.

nextDialogue.title: Mercenary
nextDialogue.plainText: I am a security consultant for small businesses.

nextDialogue.title: Mercenary
nextDialogue.plainText: You should get a security alarm if you don't already have one.

nextDialogue.title: Mercenary
nextDialogue.plainText: There's more gangs and organized crimes in the Lowers' nowdays.

mainDialogue.title: Annoyed Engineer
mainDialogue.plainText: Hiya there, got food and water?

nextDialogue.title: Annoyed Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: I am gonna be here all day doing the repairs.

nextDialogue.title: Annoyed Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: Some crazy scavenger salvaged

nextDialogue.title: Annoyed Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: the metal plating off a structural beam again.

nextDialogue.title: Annoyed Engineer
nextDialogue.plainText: I bet next, they will start stripping

mainDialogue.title: Salvage Ship Pilot
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, I am back from a salvage run around the Station

nextDialogue.title: Salvage Ship Pilot
nextDialogue.plainText: The debris and the trade ship derelicts are a gold mine.

nextDialogue.title: Salvage Ship Pilot
nextDialogue.plainText: Investing in that salvage ship was the best decision I made.

nextDialogue.title: Salvage Ship Pilot
nextDialogue.plainText: While the scavs are pushing each other for junks

nextDialogue.title: Salvage Ship Pilot
nextDialogue.plainText: in the Abandoned Sections.

mainDialogue.title: Sick Lower Level Citizen
mainDialogue.plainText: *SHIVERS*

nextDialogue.title: Sick Lower Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: Hey, I am not doing so good.

nextDialogue.title: Sick Lower Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: I need some meds, but I don't have much credits.

nextDialogue.title: Sick Lower Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: I tried getting help at the Lower Levels Clinic

nextDialogue.title: Sick Lower Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: But the line are so long,

mainDialogue.title: Lower Level Elder
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Elder
nextDialogue.plainText: Do you sell food?

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Elder
nextDialogue.plainText: There's been a burglary at my home.

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Elder
nextDialogue.plainText: All my food is gone.

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Elder
nextDialogue.plainText: I suspect it's my neighbors.

mainDialogue.title: Old Scav
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello, I got these to sell

nextDialogue.title: Old Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: It was my weapon during the Second Revolution

nextDialogue.title: Old Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: I have no use for it anymore.

nextDialogue.title: Old Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: I kept it all those years

nextDialogue.title: Old Scav
nextDialogue.plainText: hoping there would be another revolution I could join.

mainDialogue.title: Desperate Lover
mainDialogue.plainText: Please, It's urgent.

nextDialogue.title: Desperate Lover
nextDialogue.plainText: I need a variety of tools, weapons and meds.

nextDialogue.title: Desperate Lover
nextDialogue.plainText: My girlfriend went on a scav run.

nextDialogue.title: Desperate Lover
nextDialogue.plainText: She went to the Abandoned Sections.

nextDialogue.title: Desperate Lover
nextDialogue.plainText: Hasn't come back since.

mainDialogue.title: Hydroponic Farmer
mainDialogue.plainText: You there, I got some fresh Nutrifruits to sell.

nextDialogue.title: Hydroponic Farmer
nextDialogue.plainText: They are easier to grow, resistant to pest and diseases.

nextDialogue.title: Hydroponic Farmer
nextDialogue.plainText: I just wish the damn seeds weren't that expensive

nextDialogue.title: Hydroponic Farmer
nextDialogue.plainText: Why did they have to make these plants seedless?

mainDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, you got any food?

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: It's been ages since I came down here to the Lower Levels.

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: I moved up after I got lucky and won that Lottery.

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: They started the Lower Levels Lottery a while back,

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: Right after the Second Revolution ended, actually.

mainDialogue.title: Scavenger
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, I found a whole box of PEAT!

nextDialogue.title: Scavenger
nextDialogue.plainText: You ever wonder what this meat is made out of?

nextDialogue.title: Scavenger
nextDialogue.plainText: Most people think it's meat from commercial pig breed.

nextDialogue.title: Scavenger
nextDialogue.plainText: Some folks say it's vat-grown protein.

nextDialogue.title: Scavenger
nextDialogue.plainText: Me? I think it could be insects.

mainDialogue.title: Conspiracy Theorist
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello, how are you?

nextDialogue.title: Conspiracy Theorist
nextDialogue.plainText: Did you know that Station Command are actually aliens?

nextDialogue.title: Conspiracy Theorist
nextDialogue.plainText: This whole Station is a social experiment.

nextDialogue.title: Conspiracy Theorist
nextDialogue.plainText: Studying us before they invade the rest of the Republic

nextDialogue.title: Conspiracy Theorist
nextDialogue.plainText: How convenient that the rest of The Republic is so far away.

mainDialogue.title: Upper Level Servant
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello. My employers sent me to acquire supplies.

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Servant
nextDialogue.plainText: I still can't believe they're going through with this.

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Servant
nextDialogue.plainText: They're hosting a "Scav" party.

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Servant
nextDialogue.plainText: Guests from the Upper Levels Elite are dressing up as Scavs,

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Servant
nextDialogue.plainText: eating Lower Level food from tin trays.

mainDialogue.title: Corporate Waste Manager
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello, I got some hazardous waste to dispose of.

nextDialogue.title: Corporate Waste Manager
nextDialogue.plainText: Proper disposal is expensive.

nextDialogue.title: Corporate Waste Manager
nextDialogue.plainText: I'll pay you 100 Credits per barrel.
